# Little Chiku

> Little Chiku is an Indian online brand selling handcrafted, hand block printed cotton essentials for babies, kids and mothers — bath towels and bathrobes, bedding, bags, kids accessories, clothing and return-gift hampers. The brand is based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, and ships across India. Website: https://littlechiku.com

## Key facts
- Brand: Little Chiku (legal seller: Vishaa Enterprises)
- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Delivery: pan-India. Free shipping on orders above Rs. 1,499; flat Rs. 99 below that. Standard delivery 5-7 business days.
- Returns: accepted within 7 days of delivery for unused, unwashed items in original packaging; damaged or defective items must be reported within 48 hours of delivery. Full policy: https://littlechiku.com/term-condition
- Payment: orders can be placed on the website and confirmed via WhatsApp; see the cart page for available methods.
- Support: WhatsApp / call +91 77280 09522, email Vishaaenterprises@gmail.com, Mon-Sat 10am-7pm IST. Replies within 24 hours.
- Bulk and customised orders (minimum 20 pieces) are available — contact the team.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/littlechikukids/

## Shop by category
- [Bath Linen](https://littlechiku.com/category/bath-linen): waffle cotton kids towels, towel gift sets, hand towels, kids bathrobes, hooded bath ponchos
- [Bedding](https://littlechiku.com/category/bedding): hand block print percale cotton bedsheet sets, quilts, dohars and comforters
- [Bags](https://littlechiku.com/category/bags): quilted kids backpacks, pouch sets, tote and duffle bags
- [Kids Accessories](https://littlechiku.com/category/kids-accessories): cooking and painting aprons, play mats
- [Clothing](https://littlechiku.com/category/clothing): kids night suits, shorts sets, frocks, batik cotton shirts
- [Mom's Corner](https://littlechiku.com/category/moms-corner): pouches and everyday essentials for mothers
- [Return Gifts](https://littlechiku.com/category/return-gifts): curated gift hampers and gift sets for birthdays, baby showers and naming ceremonies
- [All products](https://littlechiku.com/category/all)
